verdict.rationale: The official API reference introduction says users can "Download the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec", alongside documented endpoints, auth, rate limits and errors at api.incident.io. The probe's 404s only cover guessed URLs, not the documented link, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: a confirmed live download URL for the spec (the probe did not locate it), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and current.
